items.title: Sheila Hamill Kerrigan Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: And then, oh, there's Sharky and, oh. Wild Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: Okay. Well, I'm Sheila Hamer-Kerrigan, and I was born in 1940, and I live in Paschristian, Mississippi. And the first time I ever remember jazz, really, was, I guess, when I was that 9 or 10 down at the Yacht Club Dances. They used to have Papa Celestan come over from New Orleans all during the summer to play at the Yacht Club Dances. And... Yeah, mostly New Orleans people that were there at the Yacht Club? Yeah, mostly New Orleans people, of course, but, um, I don't know, all my friends like it. And it's, I…
